plainTranslation: Composite Jupiter in the 5 House: With Composite Jupiter in the 5th house, you can enjoy your time spent doing the things you love, and you can have more opportunities to spend time on your hobbies together. You can express yourselves creatively with one another and it can flow more easily. With the 5th house ruling children, this can be a good position for a parent/child relationship or for having children together, something you’d enjoy doing together.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
